criteria.name: Market Sizing Basis
criteria.grading_prompt: Is market sizing grounded in cited sources or methodology, or is it an unsupported number?

anchors.PASS: TAM/SAM/SOM figures with named sources or explained methodology (top-down from industry report, bottom-up from user count * ARPU)
anchors.PARTIAL: Figures given with vague sourcing ('industry estimates suggest') or methodology not explained
anchors.FAIL: Market size stated as a bare number with no source or methodology
